title: What Jet Stream Turbines Is
definition: Jet Stream Turbines: turbines flying in the high-altitude jet stream.

t: Real Research Today: Jet Stream Turbines
title: Real Research Today: Jet Stream Turbines
definition: Today's documented research behind Jet Stream Turbines.
description:
The road to Jet Stream Turbines is already being paved. Perovskite solar cells have passed 33% tandem efficiency in laboratory records. Commonwealth Fusion Systems is building SPARC, a compact high-field tokamak aiming for net energy.

Small modular reactor designs (NuScale, Rolls-Royce SMR) move through licensing worldwide. Together these programs form the airborne wings foundation that Jet Stream Turbines will build on — the turbine logistics results, the tether systems methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as turbine logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

description:
First commercial turbine hulls plant sells airborne wings power to the grid under a 20-year aviation coordination contract.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed airborne wings demonstrations, turbine logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting tether systems uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Jet Stream Turbines
definition: Estimates Jet Stream Turbines readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Jet Stream Turbines components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a turbine hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Jet Stream Turbines Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Jet Stream Turbines operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Jet Stream Turbines installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 71142 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where airborne wings monitoring, turbine logistics redundancy, or tether systems maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Jet Stream Turbines Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Jet Stream Turbines: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Jet Stream Turbines — turbines flying in the high-altitude jet stream.

Phase 1 — Prove (airborne wings): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (turbine logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (tether systems): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (aviation coordination): turbine hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and stratosphere-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
